title: Don’t bother
text: Don’t bother. This looks like a great idea for garlic but don’t waste your time, mine is being returned. It takes all the strength you have to push down on the press to even get a bit of the garlic to come through the holes.

product_metadata.title: Vantic Garlic Press Rocker - Stainless Steel Garlic Mincer Garlic Crusher, New Innovative Garlic Chopper with Peeler and Scraper for Smash Garlic
features: NEW INNOVATIVE ROCKING GARLIC PRESS - This new garlic press with arc shape, comfortable handle design make squeezing a breeze, even for those with weaker grip or small hands.
CRUSH AND MINCE GARLIC EASILY - With a slight back and forth rocking motion, easily crush or mince garlic in half the time!
100% PREMIUM STAINLESS STEEL + HIGH QUALITY SILICONE - The Vantic Garlic Press is very durable, corrosion-resistant and will not rust nor break
SUPER EASY CLEAN UP AND STORE - Because the garlic collects on the surface of the rocking garlic press , there are no extra dishes to clean.
If you have any questions within one year, please contact us and we will solve it for you within 24 hours.
